# Saved research artifacts for the S-01 Evidence Core (Issue #299)

The fixed set NB-03b's acceptance evidence asks for: real research, saved, so
that "every core is referentially valid and every claim has a verdict, a
strength and a ceiling" is checked against material this repository actually
recorded rather than against something written to pass.

**Provenance.** Every source, headline, date, URL and excerpt below is copied
from signals committed in `data/research/selected_signals.jsonl` — the CNBC
Business items the live research path selected on 2026-06-22. The excerpts are
the `raw_summary` text recorded with each signal; nothing here was fetched, and
no test fetches anything. This is the same posture as
`tests/fixtures/wednesday_july/cnbc_business_2026-07-06.xml`, which reconstructs
a feed item from preserved evidence for the same reason.

**Two files per case.**

- `<case>.artifact.json` — one `NormalizedResearchArtifact` exactly as
  retrieval leaves it: every claim `not_assessed`, readiness `insufficient`, no
  assessor. That is what the adapters produce, and it is what S-01 receives.
- `<case>.response.json` — the extended assessment's answer for that artifact:
  the #125 verdicts plus the E-02 and E-03 classifications the core needs. Saved
  as data rather than generated by a rule in the test, so the real parser, the
  real coverage checks and the real `assess_artifact` path all run over a
  response shaped the way a model's is.

**What each case covers.**

| Case | Shape it exercises |
|---|---|
| `target_chair_support` | A claim the support does not establish: `rejected`, and its strength floored by code to the ladder's weakest level whatever the model read off the excerpt. Readiness becomes `needs_review`. An unresolved non-material uncertainty is carried into the core. |
| `ups_cold_chain_investment` | A figure observation with a unit, an as-of date and `third_party` provenance, and a third-party assertion. All claims usable, no open conditions: readiness becomes `ready`. |
| `lucid_workforce_reduction` | A `qualified` claim, whose caveat is the limitation its own #125 rationale names, and a claim with two observations from one source. An unresolved **material** uncertainty keeps readiness at `needs_review`. |

Three readiness outcomes across the set, on purpose: only one of them would pass
the Release 1 READY gate, and Step 2 §1 gives that decision to the ARP instead.

**The `revise` case.** `target_chair_support` is also the saved artifact the
second piece of acceptance evidence runs on: it reaches the relevance screen at
`needs_review` with the evidence gap its own rejected claim opened, so a `revise`
over it routes to enrichment rather than stopping the run
(`test_a_saved_artifact_the_lens_revises_routes_to_enrichment`).
